title: 3824. Minimum K to Reduce Array Within Limit

examples.explanation: When k = 3, nonPositive(nums, k) = 6 <= k2. Reduce nums[0] = 3 one time. nums[0] becomes 3 - 3 = 0. Reduce nums[1] = 7 three times. nums[1] becomes 7 - 3 - 3 - 3 = -2. Reduce nums[2] = 5 two times. nums[2] becomes 5 - 3 - 3 = -1.
When k = 1, nonPositive(nums, k) = 1 <= k2. Reduce nums[0] = 1 one time. nums[0] becomes 1 - 1 = 0.
